content.text:
VERDICT: LGTM

The new `getInitials()` sits exactly where the analogous derived accessor already lives — right beside `getDisplayName()` in the base `Person` class. This is the right unit: both `firstName` and `lastName` are declared on `Person`, so a derived read-only property combining them belongs here rather than in a subclass or a separate formatter, and placing it next to the existing `"LastName, FirstName"` formatter keeps all derived-name logic in one coherent spot. Both `Owner` and `Vet` inherit it for free, matching the existing pattern.

No duplication, the method does one small thing, and `Person` is not becoming a catch-all — it remains a thin domain bean with field accessors plus two derived-name getters. The OpenAPI addition mirrors the existing `name` property entry (title/description/type/example/`readOnly`) one-for-one, so the schema change is idiomatic and consistent with its neighbors. A maintainer would find this natural.
